items.source: Returns whether the current property is readable through PersistentPropertyAccessor, i.e. if it is not isTransient(), if the value can be set on the current instance or read to create a new instance as per getWither() or via Kotlin Copy methods.
items.translation: 返回当前属性是否可通过 PersistentPropertyAccessor 读取，即该属性并非 isTransient() 所定义的瞬态属性，且其值能够设置到当前实例上，或根据 getWither() 或通过 Kotlin 的 Copy 方法读取以创建新实例。

items.source: Returns the required with Method to set a property value on a new object instance or throw IllegalStateException if no wither method is available.

items.source: Return the type the property refers to in case it's an association, i.e. isAssociation() returns true. That means, that implementations must return a non-null value from this method in that case. We also recommend to return null for non-associations right away to establish symmetry between this method and isAssociation().
items.translation: 如果该属性是关联关系，则返回其类型；即isAssociation()返回true时。这意味着实现类在这种情况下必须从此方法返回一个非null值。此外，我们建议对于非关联关系直接返回null，以在isAssociation()与此方法之间建立对称性。

items.source: Returns whether the property is a potential identifier property of the owning PersistentEntity. This method is mainly used by PersistentEntity implementation to discover id property candidates on PersistentEntity creation you should rather call PersistentEntity.isIdProperty(PersistentProperty) to determine whether the current property is the id property of that PersistentEntity under consideration.
items.translation: 返回该属性是否为所属PersistentEntity的潜在标识符属性。此方法主要由PersistentEntity实现类在创建PersistentEntity时用于发现标识符属性的候选项；若要确定当前属性是否为该PersistentEntity的标识符属性，您应调用PersistentEntity.isIdProperty(PersistentProperty)。

items.source: Returns whether the current property is a potential version property of the owning PersistentEntity. This method is mainly used by PersistentEntity implementation to discover version property candidates on PersistentEntity creation you should rather call PersistentEntity.isVersionProperty(PersistentProperty) to determine whether the current property is the version property of that PersistentEntity under consideration.
items.translation: 返回当前属性是否为所属PersistentEntity的潜在版本属性。此方法主要由PersistentEntity实现类使用，以在创建PersistentEntity时发现版本属性候选项；若要确定当前属性是否为所考虑的该PersistentEntity的版本属性，您应调用PersistentEntity.isVersionProperty(PersistentProperty)。

Useful to lookup annotations that can be configured on the type but overridden on an individual property.

此方法适用于查找可在类型上配置但可被单个属性覆盖的注解。

items.source:
class Person {
        final String id;
        final String name;

        // …

        Person withName(String name) {
                return new Person(this.id, name);
        }
}

class Person {
